Anna Taborska

Anna Taborska supports the Head of Programming of the Raindance Film Festival and is responsible for rebooting the Raindance Horror strand. She is a Raindance Film School alumna, a filmmaker, screenwriter and horror author. Anna is a recipient of the Horror Writers Association’s Bram Stoker Award in the Anthology Category for “Discontinue If Death Ensues: Tales From the Tipping Point”, which was also nominated for a World Fantasy Award. Her body of work includes three short story collections: Bloody Britain, Shadowcats, and For Those who Dream Monsters, which won the Dracula Society’s Children of the Night Award. Anna has been nominated for a British Fantasy Award thrice, and a Bram Stoker Award six times, including for her illustrated storybook A Song for Barnaby Jones.
